catalogs.title: Ophelia — Polymer farm
catalogs.notes: Stay if Botany Lab spawned. That room is the polymer-farm tile.

rooms.looks: Indoor Grineer lab with plant vats, glass tanks, and polymer crates. If you see the greenhouse/lab, stay.

catalogs.title: Zabala — Nanospores farm
catalogs.notes: Stay if the Infested Reactor tile spawned.

rooms.looks: Infested ship reactor chamber — glowing core, heavy infestation on the walls.

catalogs.title: Assur / Galleon Survival
catalogs.notes: Assur farmers often look for Connector Four. Mark it if you see it.

rooms.notes: Compact connector used as a camp / loot room.
rooms.looks: Short galleon connector with a tight camp spot. Look for Connector Four's compact T-shape.

catalogs.title: Io / Gas City Survival
catalogs.notes: No must-have farm room yet. Grade uses compactness and any rooms you add.
